title: Auth0 Session Establishment Repair
outcome: A successful Auth0 login establishes a persistent NoorPath session and returns the user to the intended protected customer, operator or platform route.
actor: Authenticated NoorPath customers, approved operator members and platform administrators.
modules: Accounts owns Auth0 session establishment and normalized identity.
Web owns the Next.js network authentication boundary and protected-route redirects.
Operators and Platform retain their existing authorization policies.
routes: Protected route -> sign in -> Auth0 callback -> original route
Authenticated customer -> account and owned journey pages
Approved operator -> operator workspace and queues
Platform administrator -> admin and publication pages
Authenticated user -> logout -> unauthenticated sign-in boundary
acceptance: Auth0 is handled only at the Next.js proxy boundary.
No App Route calls auth0.middleware or returns NextResponse.next.
Successful Google login persists a session cookie.
The original relative return destination is preserved.
Customer, operator and platform access checks execute after authentication.
Logout and expired sessions return safely to sign-in.
No authorization policy or page design is weakened or redesigned.
Product Owner approval is required before merge and release deployment.
policyDecisionsRequired: Keep the existing all-access smoke-test identity until remaining slices finish.
Do not introduce phone OTP or role-administration UI in this slice.
